title: Mosaic stage ON vs OFF: wall-time delta + verdict identity
why: Confirm the mosaic is an evidence artefact only: it should add wall time but not change any verdict/score/features_digest
hypothesis: Mosaic ON adds its build cost to the per-window wall but verdicts, scores and features_digest are byte-identical to mosaic OFF
data: 30-window sample spread over 30 factories, queues/manifest_scale.json, 1080p30 HEVC; label_source none
method: repo E8.01 pipeline (eval/exp_rescore/run_e8.py) run twice per window with only jadal.mosaic.build enabled/disabled; perf_counter per stage; verdict/score/features_digest compared

title: Zero-copy GPU path attempt (NVDEC->VRAM features/embed) vs hwdownload
why: Measure the mosaic/round-trip hypothesis: can decoded frames stay GPU-resident from NVDEC through pixel-26 features and the EG2 embedder, avoiding hwdownload+re-upload
hypothesis: A GPU-resident path removes the VRAM<->RAM round trips for the pixel+EG2 branches and speeds up decode/pixel_features/eg2_embed; if the repo cannot consume CUDA frames the step is reported blocked
method: baseline repo hwdownload path vs GPU path: in-process NVDEC (torchcodec) -> jadal.gpu.features.gpu_window_features_batch on CUDA tensors -> EmbeddingGemma-2 GPU preprocess+forward directly on device tensors; per-stage perf_counter; feature deltas + EG2 cosine + verdict agreement + PCIe bytes

title: NVDEC vs CPU decode at 1080p30 HEVC and 480p H.264, with/without hwdownload
why: Settle where GPU decode wins: isolate the hwdownload cost and compare NVDEC vs CPU at both resolutions
hypothesis: NVDEC beats CPU at 1080p30 HEVC but not at 480p H.264; hwdownload adds measurable time
data: 1080p30 HEVC factory clips + 480p10 H.264 IndEgo clip; 10-s windows
method: ffmpeg CPU vs -hwaccel cuda (+ hevc_cuvid/h264_cuvid) scale_cuda, with and without hwdownload (null sink); p50 over windows

title: Upload-spec ladder: codec/resolution/CRF vs decode + zero-copy throughput
why: If the deployment can choose the upload encoding, the codec/resolution/quality is free and may dominate decode cost and end-to-end throughput
hypothesis: Lower-res H.264 uploads cut decode cost and raise footage-h/wall-h; the NVDEC-vs-CPU advantage flips toward CPU at low resolutions
data: 30-window sample (1080p30 HEVC source), transcoded to 5 upload specs; label_source none
regime: 1080p30 HEVC source; upload specs 1080p HEVC, 1080p H.264 CRF23, 480p H.264 CRF23, 360p H.264 CRF28, 240p H.264 CRF28
method: transcode 10-s segments per spec; measure NVDEC (with/without hwdownload) and CPU decode; compose total from measured resolution-invariant feature/EG2 costs; footage-h/wall-h per spec
